hypotheses.title: Quarterly Sales Yield with Short-Term Liquidity Reversal
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Actual quarterly sales annualized relative to market price isolates fundamental revenue yield (inverse price-to-sales). Companies with high top-line revenue relative to equity value are protected against earnings accrual noise and trade at persistent value premia.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha returns fail during hyper-growth tech bubbles.

hypotheses.title: Cash and Liquid Assets Buffer Solvency
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Cash and short-term investments scaled by total assets measures liquid solvency cushions. Firms with high cash buffers maintain strategic optionality and avoid distress during tight monetary cycles, outperforming leveraged peers with zero income-statement correlation.
confounders: Cash burn in early-stage pre-revenue biotech
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during low-interest speculative junk rallies.

hypotheses.title: Volume-Weighted Price Exhaustion Reversal
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Stocks experiencing rapid price appreciation accompanied by abnormal volume surges suffer institutional buying exhaustion and inventory imbalance. Linearly decaying volume-weighted returns captures market maker mean-reversion profits with zero fundamental correlation.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha inverts during sustained parabolic multi-week momentum breakouts.
